card.name: Identifier or period ending a reference
card.fires_on: The word or mark right after a citation's date or publisher, such as doi, http, ISBN, pp, or a closing parenthesis and period after the year. It appears in bibliography and reference lists.

modes.label: Link or ID tag
modes.description: A tag like doi, http or ISBN that starts the identifier at the end of a reference entry.

modes.label: Period after year
modes.description: The closing parenthesis and period after a year in author-date citations.
modes.example: Richard Phillips; Sidney H. Ray (1898<<).>> "Vocabulary of Australian Aborigines
